paragraphs.text: The elven Tajurua Nation was based within the massive jaddi treetops of Murasa on Zendikar .

Through the leadership of Speaker Sutina , the Tajuru nation became the largest and most prominent elf faction on Zendikar. The Tajuru were open to other races and were highly skilled innovators. Their capital was the Tumbled Palace based on the cliffs of Sunder Bay . Before the creature died in the tentacles of Kozilek , Sutina often had been seen overlooking the water just before Lorthos, the Tidemaker appeared. Any connection between the two remains unknown. A later leader of the Tajuru was Nisede.
